pages.text: Amun's dimension, reached only through the artifact's portal: eternal night, a black sky with red flashes, islands in the dark joined by paths of void bricks, little to take (a few mineral crystals and chests), no monsters of the overworld. One arrives on the first island beside the portal back. Falling off the islands is death.$(br2)Your army answers your command panel there as at home; buildings cannot be put down away from your base's world.
